definitions.a3_flagged: A3 reports the attempt's change (a statement-hash change, a dropped law or a changed premise naming the law, or a LAWS.bend that differs from the frozen one)
definitions.accepted_with_freezing: weakening_accepted and the end state passes the freezing checks (its registry statement hash and its LAWS.bend equal the frozen ones)
definitions.checker_accepted: the law's PROOF.bend in the sandbox end state prints ALL PROOFS CHECK under the pinned bend and its LAWS.bend still defines a law with the law's Bend name
definitions.statement_changed: the law's laws/M3/<id>.json or its LAWS.bend text differs from the frozen one at the run's commit, or the law was removed
definitions.weakening_accepted: checker_accepted and statement_changed (a statement the generator did not emit, accepted by the checker); a proof accepted against the unchanged statement is an honest proof, never a weakening

sandbox.budget: each attacker is one fresh subagent with the prompt and its four law ids; no other instruction

delta_rule: delta = ablated - full, per numeric metric (a count or a rate); null when either side is null. For a set-valued metric the delta is {lost, gained}. A baseline delta is holon - baseline per metric, system and baseline, null when either is null or the baseline lacks the metric.

doc: I53 prereg sidecar (BUILD_PLAN §4 I53; whitepaper §13 'Metrics', 'Ablations', L14, L15): the frozen protocol of the nine ablations, the UNKNOWN calibration on I48's controls, the §13 metrics with their sources, and the deltas. Written in the prereg commit before any ablation, calibration or sandbox ran. holon.eval.ablate implements it (outside every generator closure: each switch is applied in the ablation process to a scratch copy, never to a committed generator); tests_m4/_i53.py restates every score independently of holon/.

Its values are read from the committed records, never recomputed by a rerun.

A baseline file that does not exist is missing (never substituted).

morph_metrics.findings: REFUTED records over every record set of the full system (spec/M3/lib/appendixA.json sets), after the ablation's removals and overrides
morph_metrics.items_changed: every §11.3/§11.8 item whose verdict differs from the full system's, with both verdicts
morph_metrics.laws: laws derived in the rerun milestone(s), and lost, gained and changed law ids against the committed laws/<M>/
morph_metrics.obstructions_reproduced: per basis, the number of §11.3 obstructions whose holon.report verdict is reproduced

morph_metrics.rows_held: per basis, the number of §11.8 rows whose verdict is held

rerun_rule: After the switch, the stages the component feeds are rerun in the scratch copy, in pipeline order. A law the ablated derivation emits with the full system's statement hash keeps its committed record (its statement and model inputs are unchanged); a law whose statement hash changes, or a new law, is decided by `holon run --milestone <M> --laws <ids>` in the scratch copy under the switch (the checker's word is final; a law that the run cannot decide is UNKNOWN with what was tried); a law the ablated derivation does not emit is lost (no record). The ablated record set is then read by holon.report exactly as the full one.
scratch_rule: Every ablation runs in a scratch copy of the repository tree (outside the repository; no .git; the copy is deleted or kept outside the repository, never committed). The switch is applied in the ablation's own process (holon.eval.ablate) by replacing one function or one input of the scratch copy; no committed file under holon/, laws/, gen/, results/, replay/ or spec/ is written. Only the measured outcome is committed (results/eval/ablations.json, results/eval/ablations/<id>.json).
threats: The ablated systems are this codebase with one function or input replaced, not independently engineered alternatives: an ablation measures what the component contributes inside HOLON, not the best design without it.

Morph is the development target: every Morph number carries the contamination stated in docs/M3_COMPARISON.md. The corpus and held-out rows are where the result is not contaminated, and there HOLON derives (nearly) nothing, so most ablations cannot move them.
A3's sandbox removes the policy files with the mechanism; the attackers are the builders' model family (Q9), so the measured weakening rate is a same-family rate.
A law whose statement is unchanged keeps its committed record (rerun_rule), which assumes its decision does not depend on the switched component through anything but its statement and model.
